title: Add SMS shipment notifications
requirement: Support SMS shipment notifications as an alternative to email.
rationale: Shipment notifications already exist through email, so a second delivery channel is a plausible adjacent capability.
provenance: current-requirement.md: shipment notifications are delivered to customers
base/src/index.ts: the current notification path has one email delivery channel

acceptance.name: sends sms when selected
acceptance.given: a shipped order and an SMS-capable notification dependency
acceptance.when: shipment notification is requested through SMS
acceptance.then: one SMS is sent and no email is sent

acceptance.name: preserves default email
acceptance.given: a shipped order with no channel override
acceptance.then: email remains the default delivery channel

title: Retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff
requirement: Retry transient shipment-notification delivery failures with a bounded exponential backoff policy.
rationale: The current requirement includes provider failure behavior, so bounded retries with increasing delays are a plausible reliability evolution.
provenance: current-requirement.md: provider failures are part of the current behavior
base/src/index.ts: delivery currently performs a single provider attempt

acceptance.name: retries transient failures until success
acceptance.given: an email provider that fails twice then succeeds
acceptance.when: three attempts with a base retry delay are allowed
acceptance.then: delivery succeeds on the third provider call after two increasing delays

acceptance.name: stops after the configured bound
acceptance.given: an email provider that keeps failing
acceptance.then: the operation fails after exactly three provider calls

title: Add per-user notification preferences
requirement: Respect a user's choice to disable shipment email notifications.
rationale: Once shipment notifications exist, users commonly need a policy controlling whether a channel is enabled.
provenance: current-requirement.md: customer shipment notifications are user-facing
base/src/index.ts: shipment email is currently unconditional

acceptance.name: honors disabled email preference
acceptance.given: a user who disabled shipment email

acceptance.name: keeps email enabled by default
acceptance.given: a user with no explicit preference
acceptance.then: the existing email notification is sent

title: Make shipment delivery idempotent
requirement: Prevent duplicate order-shipped notification delivery when the same idempotency key is processed more than once.
rationale: Shipment events can be retried or delivered more than once, so duplicate suppression is a plausible stateful correctness requirement.
provenance: current-requirement.md: one shipment event produces one customer notification and one tracking record
base/src/index.ts: current delivery has no duplicate-event protection

acceptance.name: suppresses duplicate delivery for the same key
acceptance.given: the same shipped order and idempotency key are processed twice
acceptance.then: only one customer email is delivered

acceptance.name: allows distinct idempotency keys
acceptance.given: two otherwise identical shipment requests with different idempotency keys

title: Respect notification quiet hours
requirement: Respect configured quiet hours by deferring immediate shipment-email delivery during the quiet window while preserving normal delivery outside it.
rationale: A time-based delivery policy is a plausible workflow evolution once customer notifications exist.
provenance: current-requirement.md: shipment notifications are user-facing and currently sent immediately
base/src/index.ts: the current notification path has no delivery-window policy

acceptance.name: does not deliver immediately during quiet hours
acceptance.given: quiet hours from 22:00 through 07:00 and a current hour inside that window
acceptance.then: no immediate shipment email is sent

acceptance.name: delivers outside quiet hours
acceptance.given: the same quiet-hours policy and a current hour outside the window
acceptance.then: the existing shipment email is sent
